<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a quest item, obtained from [[Snake]] when you have the [[keepers key]] as part of the [[astrologer]]'s quest. You need at least {{Item|Faith|5}} or he will not offer you the item. Using it in the study table with the key will create the [[active key]] which can be given to [[Snake]] to unlock the [[dungeon]].
